method_used: gmx rms, fit rot+trans on index group 1 (Protein = receptor + peptide), replicate 2 against replicate 1

peptide_identity_verified.method: last five residues of the Protein group rendered as one-letter code
peptide_identity_verified.DOR: TYR1 GLY2 GLY3 PHE4 MET5 -> YGGFM
peptide_identity_verified.MOR: TYR1 GLY2 GLY3 PHE4 MET5 -> YGGFM
peptide_identity_verified.note: met-enkephalin confirmed present and at the end of the group in both receptors, so the RMSD selection is the intended solute rather than an assumed one

GATE_DESIGN_FLAW_FOUND_AND_CORRECTED.what_happened: The first evaluation applied the 0.05 nm threshold to ALL atoms and returned mean displacement 5.65 nm (DOR) and 5.47 nm (MOR), with a maximum of 18.05 nm -- larger than the box. It printed VERDICT: both pairs diverged, proceed.
GATE_DESIGN_FLAW_FOUND_AND_CORRECTED.why_it_was_invalid: The solute is 4 percent of the system: 5,830 protein atoms against 45,426 membrane and 84,575 solvent. Bulk water diffuses several nm per ns and periodic wrapping scatters it, so the metric measured solvent diffusion. Against that, 0.05 nm is unreachable in the failing direction: ANY two independent runs pass by two orders of magnitude.
GATE_DESIGN_FLAW_FOUND_AND_CORRECTED.the_defect_is_in_the_preregistration: G4 specified a threshold without specifying an atom selection. An unspecified selection defaults to everything, which for a membrane system is overwhelmingly solvent. A gate that cannot fail is not evidence, and this one would have been recorded as passed.
GATE_DESIGN_FLAW_FOUND_AND_CORRECTED.corrected_metric: solute-only RMSD after rotational and translational fitting
GATE_DESIGN_FLAW_FOUND_AND_CORRECTED.how_it_was_caught: the magnitude was physically impossible -- a mean displacement of 5.6 nm in a ~15 nm box, with a max exceeding the box, between two runs started from the SAME minimised structure

what_this_licenses: Stage 2 (the 57-window re-spaced ladder) may run, and the replicate spread it produces measures structural plus thermal variation rather than thermostat seed alone -- which is what Cycle 8's replicates measured and why their 8.53 kcal/mol spread was not genuine uncertainty.
what_this_does_NOT_license: Nothing about whether the method can resolve the effect. The pre-registered overlap, sign and accuracy gates against the published +0.81 kcal/mol are still ahead. G4 is a precondition.

measured_gpu_equilibration_rates_ns_per_.note: equilibration is plain MD so both nonbonded and PME offload to GPU; FEP keeps PME and perturbed nonbonded on CPU, which is why production stays on CPU where the comparator legs ran
